profile.headline: Software Engineer at Finvari
profile.summary: Software engineer with passion in frontend architecture and cloud native solutions. Technology evangelist, lifelong learner, tinkerer, mentor.

positions.description: Skills: Front-End Development · Communication · Workshops · Analytical Skills

positions.title: Founding Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Front-End Development · Communication · Data Analytics · Analytical Skills

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
•	Family business, hobby project
•	A service that delivers gift ideas, and quality photo prints directly to customers' doorstep
•	Developed Printopus iOS and Android apps, both are available on the Apps Store
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Communication · Workshops · Analytical Skills

positions.title: Staff Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
•	Worked end to end on helping build the SDE presence with contributions to the Apptio Academy curriculum, organizing tech talks, and mentoring engineers across teams.
•	Introduced Apptio's first Design System and React Components Library.
•	Led a team to build and evangelize the Apptio micro-frontends framework, harmonizing all new and existing applications in a single unified experience for our customers.
•	Experience with laying out foundations for new project initiatives with cloud-native CI/CD tooling and deployments on the Kubernetes platform.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
•	Co-lead a team through a multi-year refactoring project of Apptio's flagship product from a monolith application to microservices
•	Designed and rewrote an important legacy UI feature to support new product requirements
•	Implemented UI testing framework with Selenium and configured TeamCity CI to support this framework
•	Responsible for troubleshooting customer escalations and any technological concerns of the team

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
•	Inherited v1 iOS app for the iPad and maintained it while also adding multi-currency support
•	Built a v2 iOS app and implemented a pipeline for testing and delivering to the App Store
•	Maintained and enhanced Apptio RESTful API to support internal and mobile applications
•	Built a content management system app in React for the Sales department, used for sales training and references
•	Built an Alexa app that won the CEO’s favorite prize at Apptio Hackathon, demoed at a conference to customers in Europe
•	Mentored SDE interns, providing development and SDLC training, with 100% returning as full-time employees
•	Worked in an agile development environment and engaged in best SDLC practices

positions.title: Software Development Engineer I
positions.description:
•	Built reusable UI widgets and implemented features on flagship product platform to meet business needs
•	Worked in an agile development environment and engaged in best SDLC practices

positions.title: Student Developer
positions.description:
• Researched and prototyped a redesign project of GTMobile apps interface on the Ionic Framework
• Developed a mobile web app to present campus buildings' utility usages in graphical data visualization utilizing D3.js

company.name: Georgia Tech - Research Network Operations Center

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed an internal Showcase Application that displays developers’ UI widgets with documentation
• Utilized Google Web Toolkit to create/enhance UI widgets that are currently used in the product

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Augmented the existing data of master brands with additional data scrapped from external sources.
• Utilized HtmlUnit, Google API, Bing API, and LinkedIn API to develop a script to find brand canonical sites and brand logos.
• Set up a JSON data API that connects to a relational database for the brand augmentation tool.

positions.title: Student Outreach Associate
positions.description:
•	Serve as Seattle Central student leader, participate in student panels, campus tours, college fairs, and campus events.
•	Represent, promote and recruit community members to the college.

volunteerExperiences.description:
•	Refurbished second-hand computers for shipment to non-profits, schools and other organizations
•	Upgraded, fixed computers, identified parts and installed hard drives, memory, software and operating systems

projects.title: Cloud SMS
projects.description: Cloud SMS allows users to send and receive SMS messages via their computers. This application interacts with user's Android device to ask it to send the messages by itself. Therefore, it uses current user phone number, which basically the same as texting on the phone, but now on the computer. Please click on the project's name to see a demo.

projects.title: SpaceTrader
projects.description: A classic game of Space Trader that utilizes the Android SDK. The original game was developed by Pieter Spronck. This game is implemented by myself and 3 other teammates at Georgia Tech.
